data.narrative:
Andrenam is a Defense & Security seed-stage company founded by Matej Cernosek and Alex Chu that has raised $18M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed through Series A stages in the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $18M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $45M valuation. The peer-median method references 4 directly comparable companies at seed or Series A stage (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M), yielding a median valuation of $700M. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $38M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $372M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty inherent in the Defense & Security seed stage, where comparable companies exhibit substantial variance in scale and funding trajectory. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods—$45M versus $700M—suggests valuation depends critically on assumptions about Andrenam's competitive positioning relative to high-growth peers like UFORCE, the primary source of upside in the range.
